evidence.detail: Single edit_rules() controller loads all rules, doubled/mistagged/overlooked decks in one shot with no per-archetype routing
EditRules view renders all rules sorted together; no per-archetype split in template or view

Second comment from bakert: 'Edit Rules is a lot faster than it used to be when this ticket was created, and has a few usability improvements. But it is a giant page of about 1000 forms and will only grow.'

triage.notes: Some performance improvements were already made but the structural change (one subpage per archetype) was not implemented; would require new routes, partial data loading, and template restructuring.
